# std.sorted

<!-- Generated by `badger doc std` from the checked interfaces (badger 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

Ordered maps: a persistent AVL tree keyed by `<`. `get`, `insert`,
`remove`, `first`, `last`, `floor`, and `ceiling` take O(log n); `range`
and `to_list` yield entries in key order. Every operation returns a new
map and leaves the old one unchanged.

    let m = sorted.empty<Int, String>().insert(3, "c").insert(1, "a")
    m.first()               // .some((1, "a"))
    m.range(1, 3)           // [(1, "a")]   (from inclusive, to exclusive)
